feature_formulas.favorable_wick_atr: (high-max(open,close) for Boom; min(open,close)-low for Crash) / A
feature_formulas.adverse_wick_atr: (min(open,close)-low for Boom; high-max(open,close) for Crash) / A
feature_formulas.favorable_close_position: (close-low for Boom; high-close for Crash) / R
feature_formulas.large_completed_bar: float(R > 3 * A.shift(1)); unknown if candle or lagged A is missing
feature_formulas.log1p_large_bar_age: log1p(min(M5 bars since last large_completed_bar,288)); unknown before first or after a gap
feature_formulas.aligned_distance_prior_favorable_12_atr: s * (close - favorable preceding12bar extreme) / A; high for Boom, low for Crash
feature_formulas.aligned_distance_prior_adverse_12_atr: s * (close - adverse preceding12bar extreme) / A; low for Boom, high for Crash
feature_formulas.h1_recent_m5_sweep_reclaim: float(min(M5.low,3)<H1.low for Boom; max(M5.high,3)>H1.high for Crash; AND H1.low<M5.close<H1.high); unknown if any input missing
feature_formulas.m15_favorable_fvg_atr: max(0,M15.low-M15.high.shift(2) for Boom; M15.low.shift(2)-M15.high for Crash)/M15.A
feature_formulas.m1_favorable_fvg_atr: max(0,M1.low-M1.high.shift(2) for Boom; M1.low.shift(2)-M1.high for Crash)/M1.A
